risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the tire sidewall showing brand/model and full size (e.g., 205/55R16) plus DOT code.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used tires with unknown size/model (worst-case for comparables).

risks.risk: Tread depth may be less than claimed (90% cannot be verified from these images).
risks.proof: Photo of tread wear bars and/or a tread depth gauge reading (mm) at 3–4 points on one tire.

risks.risk: Possible hidden repairs (patches) or internal damage not visible in wide shots.
risks.proof: Close-up of the inner liner and sidewall for any repair marks + a photo of the tire interior (and valve area).

risks.risk: Bulges/cuts/sidewall damage may exist but are not clearly visible from these angles.
risks.proof: 360° video/series of close-up sidewall shots (especially shoulders and bead area).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if there could be minor sidewall issues (worst-case).

risks.risk: Age verification: claim of 2023 removal cannot be confirmed without DOT date code.
risks.proof: Clear photo of DOT code on at least one tire (week/year).
risks.if_unproven: Price as older used tires (worst-case age).

proof_requests: Clear sidewall close-up showing brand + exact size + DOT date code (week/year).
Tread depth proof: wear bars close-up and/or tread depth gauge readings (mm) at multiple points.
Close-up of inner liner and sidewall for any patch/repair marks.
360° sidewall/shoulder close-ups (or short video) to confirm no bulge/cuts.
